summary: FBRX Shield, FBRX's own antivirus, and the choice of what protects your computer: FBRX Shield, Microsoft Defender, or the antivirus you already have.
notes: FBRX Shield is now FBRX's antivirus: it checks new downloads as they arrive, scans (quick, full or a folder), keeps a threat database of known malware up to date every day, and spots disguised programs, scripts that delete backups or turn off antivirus, risky files from the internet and documents with macros.
Malware goes into an encrypted quarantine straight away; suspicious files wait for you (quarantine, trust or delete), and Fabrix can explain any finding.

Choose what protects this computer: FBRX Shield, Microsoft Defender, or an antivirus already installed (Sophos, CrowdStrike, SentinelOne, ESET and more). FBRX shows its status everywhere and warns you when it is off or out of date.
The sidebar's Shield section is now Stronghold: FBRX Shield, approvals, credentials, governance and backups.
FBRX Command shows each computer's antivirus and can choose it for a group.
Endpoint Ultra adds scheduled scans and second engines (ClamAV, VirusTotal).

server.summary: FBRX Server: the FBRX Virtual hypervisor, the AI role for the whole mesh, FBRX Gate and FBRX MiniDome.
